# KB-ISCE2-001

- 엔진(engine): `isce2`
- 단계(stage): `coregister`
- 심각도(severity): **FAIL**
- 패턴 검증(pattern_verified): **예** — 업스트림 소스 문자열에서 도출
- 패턴 출처(pattern_source): components/isceobj/TopsProc/runComputeBaseline.py ('No common bursts found for swath {0}', 'No swaths contain any burst overlaps ... cannot continue for interferometry applications'); components/isceobj/Sensor/TOPS/Sentinel1.py ('NODATA: No bursts to extract', 'There is no imagery to extract. Check region of interest and inputs.'); components/isceobj/TopsProc/runTopo.py ('There is no common region between the two dates to process')

## 패턴 (regex)

```text
No common bursts found for swath (?P<swath>\d)|No swaths contain any burst overlaps|NODATA: No bursts to extract|There is no imagery to extract\. Check region of interest and inputs|There is no common region between the two dates to process
```

## 원인 (Cause)

참조 영상과 보조 영상 사이에 공통 burst가 없습니다. 두 날짜의 프레임(슬라이스)이 서로 다른 구간을 덮거나, 지정한 bbox가 어느 한 날짜의 burst와 겹치지 않거나, 서로 다른 트랙(relative orbit)의 영상을 섞었을 때 발생합니다.

_EN_: The reference and secondary acquisitions share no common bursts. This happens when the two dates' frames (slices) cover different segments, when the bbox does not intersect the bursts of one date, or when scenes from different tracks (relative orbits) are mixed.

## 조치 (Fix)

같은 relative orbit·같은 편파의 영상만 스택에 넣고, 모든 날짜에 공통으로 존재하는 burst만 AOI로 선택하세요('wintersar precheck'의 SEL 규칙이 이를 검사합니다). topsStack에서는 '-b/--bbox'를 모든 날짜가 덮는 범위로 줄이거나, 공통 burst가 없는 날짜를 '-x/--exclude_dates'로 제외하세요.

_EN_: Keep only scenes with the same relative orbit and polarization in the stack and restrict the AOI to bursts present on every date ('wintersar precheck' SEL rules check this). In topsStack, shrink '-b/--bbox' to the area covered by all dates or drop the dates without common bursts with '-x/--exclude_dates'.

## 자동 재시도 제안 (retry_hint)

```yaml
stage: precheck
action: manual
params: {}
note: Re-run selection with common-burst filtering; no automatic retry of coregistration.
```
